chunks: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Barda'i narrated to us. He said: Umar b. Abi Aylan al-Thaqafi and Isa b. Sulayman b. Abd al-Malik al-Qurashi narrated to us. They said: Abu Ibrahim al-Tarjumani narrated to us. He said: Sa'd b. Sa'id al-Jarjani narrated to us. He said: Nahshal b. Sa'id narrated to me from al-Dahhak from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may God bless him and his family) said:
The nobles of my nation are the carriers of the Quran and the companions of the night [prayer].

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ اللَّيْلِ: Companions of the night (those who pray at night)
key_terms.حَمَلَةُ الْقُرْآنِ: Carriers of the Quran (those who memorize and practice it)

ai.seo_question: Who are the nobles of the Muslim nation according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad identifies two groups as the most honourable members of his community: those who memorize and carry the Quran, and those who dedicate themselves to night prayer. This concise prophetic saying emphasizes that true spiritual nobility comes from devotion to God's word and voluntary worship in the quiet of the night.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Barada`i narrated to us. He said: `Umar b. Abi `Iylan al-Thaqafi and `Isa b. Sulayman b. `Abd al-Malik al-Qurashi narrated to us. They said: Abu Ibrahim al-Tarjamani narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. Sa`id al-Jarjani narrated to us. He said: Nahshal b. Sa`id narrated to me from al-Dahhak from Ibn `Abbas.  He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
The nobles of my Nation are those who carry the Quran and the companions of the night [prayer].
